answer_1.quote: The success of neural methods ... led to recent development of neural 'end-to-end' (e2e) architectures in natural language generation (NLG), where a direct mapping from meaning representations (MRs) to text is learned ... we address that question using the T5-Large implementation ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated English texts (exhibit descriptions, historical fact statements) derived from meaning representations.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the double test set style ... we use stratified approximate randomization (AR) to identify whether differences between the performance of various models over several runs is significant. ... we measure discourse relation errors, RHOs, lexical hallucinations, and mistID errors.
